app.tagline: Read-only audit of the security configuration of a Windows workstation or server.
audit.confidential: The report is confidential: do not leave it on the USB stick.
audit.counts: Issues: {critical} critical, {warning} warning, {info} info · {not_checked} not checked
audit.hint_admin: Run Aplomb as administrator to perform every check.
audit.not_elevated: Warning: Aplomb is not running as administrator. Some checks (BitLocker, Defender exclusions, share permissions…) will be marked "not checked".
audit.not_windows: Auditing a machine is only possible on Windows. On another system, use "aplomb evaluate --input snapshot.json".
cli.global: Global options: --lang fr|en, --data <folder> (or APLOMB_DATA). "aplomb <command> -h" for a command's options.
cli.press_enter: Press Enter to close this window.
cmd.audit: audits this machine in the console and generates the report
cmd.collect: collects the raw configuration as JSON (snapshot, no evaluation)
cmd.config: shows or changes the configuration (technician, company, logo, languages, profile)
cmd.evaluate: evaluates a saved snapshot or JSON report and generates the report
cmd.gui: opens the graphical interface (default; console audit if WebView2 is missing)
cmd.hello: prints a welcome message (binary smoke test)
config.header: # Aplomb configuration (rewritten by "aplomb config"). See the README for disabled rules (disabled_rules).
evaluate.need_input: Specify the file to evaluate: --input snapshot.json
flag.audit.no-open: do not open the HTML report
flag.config.logo: PNG/JPEG/SVG logo, relative to the aplomb-data folder
flag.config.profile: default profile: workstation | server | dc (empty: detection)
flag.evaluate.input: snapshot or JSON report to evaluate
flag.evaluate.no-open: do not open the HTML report
flag.gui.smoke: closes the window as soon as it is ready (launch test)
gui.accept.placeholder: e.g. old copier using SMBv1, replacement planned in 2027
gui.accept.text: The rule will be disabled in config.yaml for all future audits. The issue will appear in the report as "accepted risk", with your justification, and will no longer count in the score.
gui.accept.title: Accept the risk — {id}
gui.audit.elevate_text: BitLocker, Defender exclusions, other accounts' tasks and LSA protection cannot be checked: they will be marked "not checked" and excluded from the score.
gui.audit.lead: Aplomb inspects the local security configuration (services, tasks, accounts, BitLocker, Defender, SMB, firewall, hardening) and produces a report with a score and the remediation commands.
gui.audit.readonly: Read-only: Aplomb changes nothing on the machine. Only the report and aplomb-data are written, next to the exe.
gui.audit.title: Audit this machine
gui.copy_failed: Copy failed: select the text and press Ctrl+C.
gui.error.no_collection: This report does not contain the raw collection: it cannot be re-evaluated.
gui.error.not_report: This file is not an Aplomb report.
gui.error.outside: Only files in the data folder can be opened.
gui.fallback.frontend: This executable was built without the graphical interface: the audit runs in the console.
gui.fallback.webview2: The Microsoft Edge WebView2 component is not installed on this machine (common on Windows Server 2016 to 2022): the audit runs in the console.
gui.history.empty: No report yet: run a first audit.
gui.history.lead: Reports already produced in aplomb-data, for all machines.
gui.history.title: History
gui.item.gpo: Enforced by GPO — fix it in the policy:
gui.results.from_history: Report from the history, collected on {date}.
gui.settings.accepted_lead: Each disabled rule appears in the report as "accepted risk", with its justification.
gui.settings.lead: Saved in config.yaml, in the data folder:
gui.settings.logo_hint: PNG, JPEG or SVG. Placed in aplomb-data, it is saved as a relative path and follows the USB stick.
gui.settings.title: Settings
hello.readonly: Aplomb changes nothing on the audited machine: it reads the configuration and produces a report.
host.name: Name
note.absent: Feature not present on this machine
note.defender_passive: Defender is in passive mode ({a0}): another antivirus provides protection
note.not_joined: Machine joined to neither a domain nor Entra ID
note.other_av: Another antivirus is active ({a0}): Defender is normally in passive mode
note.partial_tasks: Partial check: without administrator rights, other accounts' tasks are not visible
note.profile: Does not apply to this kind of machine ({a0})
reason.absent: Feature not present on this machine
report.annex_help: Values observed on the machine for each check.
report.confidential: CONFIDENTIAL — this report describes the machine's weaknesses: do not leave it on a USB stick or in a shared folder.
report.footer: Report generated by Aplomb {version} — free (GPL-3.0) read-only compliance checking tool, intended for the machine's administrator or a mandated provider.
report.gpo_fix: This setting is enforced by a group policy (GPO/Intune): fix it in the policy, otherwise the local fix will be overwritten
report.not_checked_help: These checks could not be performed; they do not count in the score.
report.readonly: read-only audit, the machine was not changed
report.title: Security audit
script.desc1: ALL FIXES ARE COMMENTED OUT: read each block, then remove the leading "#" to apply the ones you choose.
script.desc2: Run it in a PowerShell console opened as administrator, on the audited machine only.
script.desc3: Use -WhatIf to simulate without changing anything. Actions are logged to a .log file next to the script.
script.desc4: Blocks starting with "##" relate to a setting enforced by group policy: fix it in the GPO, otherwise it will be restored.
script.gpo: Setting enforced by policy (GPO/Intune): fix it in the policy
script.manual: No automatic command: manual fix (see the report).
script.need_admin: Run this script in a PowerShell console opened as administrator.
script.nothing: No fix to suggest: no check failed.
script.wrong_host: This script was generated for machine {host}: it must not be run anywhere else.
summary.accepted: {n} risk(s) accepted by decision of the person in charge, listed separately.
summary.capped: At least one critical issue is present: the grade is capped at C (raw score {raw}/100).
summary.coverage: {coverage}% of the checks could be performed.
summary.coverage_admin: {coverage}% of the checks could be performed — run Aplomb as administrator for a complete audit.
summary.grade.A: The security configuration of this machine is very good (score {score}/100).
summary.grade.B: The security configuration of this machine is good (score {score}/100); a few points remain to be fixed.
summary.grade.C: The security configuration of this machine is average (score {score}/100): fixes are needed.
summary.grade.D: The security configuration of this machine is poor (score {score}/100): several significant weaknesses should be fixed soon.
summary.grade.E: The security configuration of this machine is very poor (score {score}/100): it is exposed and must be fixed as a priority.
summary.no_issue: No issue was found among the checks performed.
